hero.title: DDashBoard

forum.title: Forum & Chat
forum.desc: Discuss, share replays, chat in real-time.

stats.title: DDNet & KoG Stats
stats.desc: Points, ranks, maps — all in one place.

friends.title: Friends System

ddnet.title: DDNet Bingo & Race
ddnet.description: 13 categories — Novice to Insane. Difficulty filtering, solo & team modes, real-time progress tracking via DDNet API. Users with special roles can create custom categories.

kog.title: KoG Bingo & Race
kog.description: Same gameplay on KoG maps. 7 categories — Easy to Extreme. 1000+ gores maps with difficulty stars.
kog.detection: Finish detection via kog.tw profile parsing. Snapshot-based — no API needed.

download.title: Download Client
download.description: Modified DDNet client with built-in Bingo & Race UI. Create and play games without leaving the client.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join the DDashBoard community. Chat, share replays, find teammates, and stay up to date.
community.discordDesc: Chat, voice channels, game announcements, find teammates
community.powered: Powered by the DDNet & KoG community

footer.freeDesc: DDashBoard is a free community platform for DDNet and KoG players. No ads, no paywalls, no tracking — just play.
